name: Liel Ashley
source:
The Blader's Blader whose mother was also a well-known Blader in her own right. She dislikes being treated as an idol by the Dolphin Blade team. Although she quit the team in protest at the team's decision to market her as an idol rather than as a racing athlete, her situation at the start of the game hasn't really changed in actuality. 

Although she's loath to admit it, she loves ice cream and collecting stuffed toys, traits typically considered normal for girls her age.

Her dedication to the racing cause frequently leads her to push her body beyond its limits, forcing her to stop practice to allow her to recover.
